sentences.english: Let's watch a movie tonight.
sentences.chinese: 今晚我们看个电影吧。
sentences.scene: 晚饭后提议一起看电影

sentences.english: I love to watch the sunset from my balcony; the colors are amazing.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢在阳台上看日落，颜色美极了。
sentences.scene: 分享傍晚看夕阳的小确幸

sentences.english: When I was a kid, I used to watch cartoons every Saturday morning while eating a big bowl of cereal in my pajamas.
sentences.chinese: 小时候，每个星期六早上我都穿着睡衣，一边吃一大碗麦片一边看动画片。
sentences.scene: 回忆童年周末看动画的快乐时光

sentences.english: Don't watch too much TV.
sentences.chinese: 别看太多电视。
sentences.scene: 家长提醒孩子注意用眼

sentences.english: We bought a new TV for the living room, and the picture is super clear.
sentences.chinese: 我们给客厅买了台新电视，画面特别清晰。
sentences.scene: 家庭添置新家电后的兴奋

sentences.english: I usually just leave the TV on for background noise when I'm home alone, even if I'm not really watching anything.
sentences.chinese: 我一个人在家时，通常就把电视开着当背景音，哪怕其实根本没在看。
sentences.scene: 独处时用电视声音作伴的习惯

sentences.english: I have a lot of homework today.
sentences.chinese: 我今天有很多作业。
sentences.scene: 放学后向朋友抱怨

sentences.english: I can't go out until I finish my math homework, so give me an hour.
sentences.chinese: 没做完数学作业我不能出去，等我一个小时。
sentences.scene: 拒绝邀约时说明要先完成作业

sentences.english: My little brother always tries to get the dog to eat his homework, but the dog is too smart and just sniffs it and walks away.
sentences.chinese: 我弟弟总想让狗吃掉他的作业，但狗狗太聪明了，只是闻一闻就走开了。
sentences.scene: 讲弟弟逃避作业的搞笑借口

sentences.english: I got first place in the race.
sentences.chinese: 我在赛跑中得了第一名。
sentences.scene: 兴奋地分享比赛成绩

sentences.english: First, wash your hands, and then you can have a snack.
sentences.chinese: 先洗手，然后你就可以吃点心。
sentences.scene: 妈妈给孩子吃东西前立规矩

sentences.english: The first time I tried to ride a bike without training wheels, I fell straight into a bush and my dad had to pull me out.
sentences.chinese: 我第一次尝试不用辅助轮骑自行车，直接摔进了灌木丛，爸爸只好把我拽出来。
sentences.scene: 回忆学骑车的滑稽初次尝试

sentences.english: My shoes are all wet.
sentences.chinese: 我的鞋子全湿了。
sentences.scene: 踩到水坑后抱怨

sentences.english: Be careful, the floor is wet because I just mopped it.
sentences.chinese: 小心，地板是湿的，我刚拖过。
sentences.scene: 提醒家人注意刚拖过的地面

sentences.english: We got caught in the rain without umbrellas and our clothes were so wet that we had to change as soon as we got home.
sentences.chinese: 我们没带伞被雨淋了，衣服湿透了，一回家就得赶紧换掉。
sentences.scene: 突遇暴雨的狼狈经历

sentences.english: I run every morning before breakfast.
sentences.chinese: 我每天早饭前都跑步。
sentences.scene: 谈论晨跑习惯

sentences.english: We had to run to catch the bus, but we missed it by just a few seconds.
sentences.chinese: 我们不得不跑着去赶公交，结果还是差几秒没赶上。
sentences.scene: 赶公交的日常遗憾

sentences.english: When the fire alarm went off, everyone started to run toward the exit, but we had to stay calm and walk quickly instead.
sentences.chinese: 火警响起时，大家开始朝出口跑，但我们必须保持冷静，改为快速行走。
sentences.scene: 紧急疏散时的正确做法

sentences.english: We watch TV in the living room.
sentences.chinese: 我们在客厅看电视。
sentences.scene: 介绍家庭公共区域的功能

sentences.english: The living room looks so cozy with the new rug and the soft pillows.
sentences.chinese: 加了新地毯和软抱枕后，客厅看起来好温馨。
sentences.scene: 布置后欣赏客厅的新面貌

sentences.english: Every Christmas, we all gather in the living room around the fireplace, drink hot chocolate, and open presents together.
sentences.chinese: 每年圣诞节，我们全家都聚在客厅壁炉旁，喝着热巧克力，一起拆礼物。
sentences.scene: 家庭圣诞团聚的温馨时刻

sentences.english: Is it safe to cross the street?
sentences.chinese: 过马路安全吗？
sentences.scene: 孩子问家长是否可以过街

sentences.english: Please put your seatbelt on; I want to make sure everyone is safe.
sentences.chinese: 请系好安全带，我要确保每个人都安全。
sentences.scene: 开车前提醒乘客系安全带

sentences.english: When I got lost at the mall as a child, a security guard helped me find my mom, and he told me to always remember that stores are safe places to ask for help.
sentences.chinese: 小时候在商场走丢时，一个保安帮我找到了妈妈，他告诉我一定要记住商店是可以求助的安全地方。
sentences.scene: 走失后得到安全建议的童年经历

sentences.english: What does this word mean?
sentences.chinese: 这个单词是什么意思？
sentences.scene: 阅读时碰到生词询问

sentences.english: I can't remember the English word for that tool; it's on the tip of my tongue.
sentences.chinese: 我记不起那个工具的英文单词了，就在嘴边上。
sentences.scene: 努力回忆某个单词

sentences.english: My grandmother always says that a kind word costs nothing but can change someone's whole day.
sentences.chinese: 我奶奶总说，一句善意的话不花一分钱，却可能改变某人的一整天。
sentences.scene: 奶奶分享的人生智慧

sentences.english: Wash your hands before dinner.
sentences.chinese: 晚饭前洗洗手。
sentences.scene: 饭前家长提醒

sentences.english: I need to wash the car this weekend; it's covered in dust and bird droppings.
sentences.chinese: 这周末我得洗车，车上全是灰和鸟粪。
sentences.scene: 看着脏车决定周末清洗

sentences.english: After painting the fence, it took me forever to wash all the green paint off my hands and arms.
sentences.chinese: 刷完栅栏后，我花了超长时间才把手上和胳膊上的绿漆洗掉。
sentences.scene: 干完粉刷活后费力清洗

sentences.english: Thank you, that was very helpful.
sentences.chinese: 谢谢你，那非常有帮助。
sentences.scene: 对别人的帮助表示感谢

sentences.english: The lady at the information desk was so helpful and gave us a map.
sentences.chinese: 咨询台的那位女士特别热心，给了我们一张地图。
sentences.scene: 在陌生地方得到热心的指引

sentences.english: I found a really helpful video online that explained the math problem step by step, and it finally made sense to me.
sentences.chinese: 我在网上找到了一个超有用的视频，一步步讲解了那道数学题，我终于弄明白了。
sentences.scene: 通过视频讲解攻克学习难题

sentences.english: The music is too loud.
sentences.chinese: 音乐太大声了。
sentences.scene: 觉得噪音扰人时抱怨

sentences.english: My neighbors are having a loud party again, and I can't get any sleep.
sentences.chinese: 我的邻居又在办吵闹的派对，我根本睡不着。
sentences.scene: 被派对噪音干扰睡眠

sentences.english: The thunder was so loud last night that it woke up our dog, who then jumped on my bed and hid under the blanket.
sentences.chinese: 昨晚雷声太响了，把我家狗吵醒了，它跳上床躲进了被子底下。
sentences.scene: 雷声吓到宠物的有趣场景

sentences.english: I need more sleep.
sentences.chinese: 我需要多睡会儿。
sentences.scene: 早晨赖床时的感叹

sentences.english: I usually go to sleep around 11, but last night I stayed up until 2.
sentences.chinese: 我通常11点左右睡觉，但昨晚熬到了两点。
sentences.scene: 和朋友聊睡眠习惯

sentences.english: I tried to sleep on the plane, but the baby behind me kept crying and the seat was so uncomfortable that I just gave up.
sentences.chinese: 我试图在飞机上睡觉，但身后的婴儿一直哭，座位又很不舒服，我干脆放弃了。
sentences.scene: 长途飞行中难以入眠的遭遇

sentences.english: Go to your bedroom now.
sentences.chinese: 现在回你的卧室去。
sentences.scene: 家长让孩子回自己房间

sentences.english: I painted my bedroom walls light blue to make it feel more peaceful.
sentences.chinese: 我把卧室墙刷成了浅蓝色，让它感觉更宁静。
sentences.scene: 分享卧室的改造效果

sentences.english: My bedroom is my favorite place in the house because I can just close the door, lie on my bed, and read or listen to music without anyone bothering me.
sentences.chinese: 我的卧室是我在家最喜欢的地方，因为我可以关上门，躺在床上看看书、听听音乐，没人打扰。
sentences.scene: 描述卧室作为个人避风港的感受

sentences.english: Mom is cooking in the kitchen.
sentences.chinese: 妈妈正在厨房做饭。
sentences.scene: 孩子向爸爸汇报妈妈的动向

sentences.english: The kitchen smells amazing because my grandma is baking cookies.
sentences.chinese: 厨房闻起来香极了，因为我奶奶正在烤饼干。
sentences.scene: 被烘焙香味吸引到厨房

sentences.english: Our kitchen is always the busiest room in the house during the holidays because everyone is helping cook, sneaking bites, and telling stories.
sentences.chinese: 过节时，我家厨房总是最热闹的房间，因为每个人都帮忙做饭、偷吃、讲故事。
sentences.scene: 假日厨房里全家的忙碌与欢乐

sentences.english: I need to study for the test.
sentences.chinese: 我需要为考试复习。
sentences.scene: 拒绝出去玩时说明理由

sentences.english: My dad turned the spare room into a study so he can work from home.
sentences.chinese: 我爸把空闲房间改成了书房，这样他就能在家办公了。
sentences.scene: 介绍家中的新书房

sentences.english: I can't study with any noise around, so I always go to the library where it's dead silent and I can actually focus.
sentences.chinese: 周围有声音我就没法学习，所以我总是去图书馆，那里安静极了，我能真正集中注意力。
sentences.scene: 分享自己需要绝对安静的学习环境

sentences.english: The bathroom is down the hall.
sentences.chinese: 卫生间在走廊那头。
sentences.scene: 给客人指路

sentences.english: Someone is in the bathroom, so I'll have to wait to take a shower.
sentences.chinese: 有人在用卫生间，所以我得等一会儿才能洗澡。
sentences.scene: 早上排队用卫生间的日常

sentences.english: I accidentally locked myself in the bathroom when I was a kid, and my dad had to use a screwdriver to get me out.
sentences.chinese: 我小时候不小心把自己锁在卫生间里了，我爸只好用螺丝刀把我弄出来。
sentences.scene: 童年被困卫生间的搞笑回忆

sentences.english: I think so.
sentences.chinese: 我想是的。
sentences.scene: 表示同意的简短回答

sentences.english: What do you think about this new restaurant? Should we try it?
sentences.chinese: 你觉得这家新餐厅怎么样？我们要不要试试？
sentences.scene: 征求朋友对餐厅的意见

sentences.english: I've been thinking about changing my major, but I'm not sure if it's the right move yet.
sentences.chinese: 我一直在想要不要换专业，但还不确定这是不是正确的选择。
sentences.scene: 和朋友聊人生规划的犹豫

sentences.english: I have to work late tonight.
sentences.chinese: 我今晚得加班。
sentences.scene: 回家路上电话告知家人

sentences.english: My phone isn't working properly; the screen keeps freezing.
sentences.chinese: 我手机出毛病了，屏幕老卡住。
sentences.scene: 跟朋友抱怨手机故障

sentences.english: It took a lot of hard work to fix up our old house, but now it feels exactly like home.
sentences.chinese: 翻修我们的老房子花了很多心血，但现在它完全有了家的感觉。
sentences.scene: 谈论翻修房子付出后的满足感

sentences.english: This chair is too hard.
sentences.chinese: 这把椅子太硬了。
sentences.scene: 抱怨坐得不舒服

sentences.english: I studied really hard for the exam, so I hope I do well.
sentences.chinese: 我为考试非常努力地复习了，希望能考好。
sentences.scene: 表达对考试结果的期待

sentences.english: Learning to play the guitar was really hard at first, but after months of practice, I can finally play a whole song without messing up.
sentences.chinese: 刚学弹吉他时真的很难，但经过几个月的练习，我终于能完整弹一首曲子了，一点不出错。
sentences.scene: 分享学乐器由难到易的进步

sentences.english: Follow me, please.
sentences.chinese: 请跟我来。
sentences.scene: 引导客人去房间

sentences.english: I didn't quite follow the instructions; can you explain it again?
sentences.chinese: 我没太听懂那些说明，你能再解释一遍吗？
sentences.scene: 没理解步骤时请求重复

sentences.english: My dog follows me everywhere I go in the house, from the kitchen to the bathroom, and waits outside the door until I come out.
sentences.chinese: 我在家里走到哪，狗狗就跟到哪，从厨房跟到卫生间，然后蹲在门外等我出来。
sentences.scene: 描述忠诚的宠物寸步不离的可爱习惯

sentences.english: I feel tired today.
sentences.chinese: 我今天觉得累。
sentences.scene: 和朋友说起自己的状态

sentences.english: Feel this fabric—it's so soft! I think I'll buy the shirt.
sentences.chinese: 你摸摸这布料，好软！我想买这件衬衫。
sentences.scene: 购物时触摸面料做决定

sentences.english: After being sick for a whole week, I finally feel well enough to go outside and get some fresh air.
sentences.chinese: 病了一整周后，我终于感觉好到可以出门呼吸点新鲜空气了。
sentences.scene: 病愈后初次外出的舒畅感
